encoding.constant_tiles: file=null: every pixel including gutters has constant_code; synthesize this exact uint16 code.
encoding.interpolation: Decode RG to scalar elevation before interpolation or mip reduction; do not interpolate packed channels.
encoding.sampling: Exact native source cells, no spatial resampling, averaging or exaggeration

grid.gutters: One exact neighbouring native cell. Longitude wraps; latitude clamps to terminal source row.
grid.mipmaps: None. Independent tile mipmaps require additional seam treatment.
grid.resolution_note: Native 60-arc-second grid spacing; about 1.85km north-south, longitude spacing decreases with latitude. Grid spacing is not a claim of uniform survey accuracy.

landmark_note: Original source cell at the supplied coordinate; not a surveyed summit height.

reproducibility.source_code_hash_normalization: UTF-8 text with LF line endings
